financials.title: Financials
financials.subtitle: Each company keeps its own books · trial balance, account ledgers and statements of account · profit and loss and the balance sheet are on Schedule III statements
financials.noCompany: No company yet. Add one under Admin → Companies.
financials.tbNote: Opening balance, debits and credits in the period and the closing balance of every ledger, from the posted books. Click an account to open its ledger.
financials.hideZero: Hide ledgers with no balance or entries
financials.tbEmptyBody: Ledgers come from the Tally import or Admin → Tally books → Chart of accounts.
financials.pickAccountTitle: Choose a ledger to see its entries.
financials.pickAccountBody: Or click a ledger on the Trial balance tab.
financials.pickPartyBody: The statement lists every posted entry for the party in the period, with the running balance.
financials.adminOnly: This statement includes documents only Admin can see. Ask Admin to open or send it.
financials.statementRule: A statement that includes bills without GST is opened only by Admin or the CA.
financials.whoAdmin: Admin: every transaction, with GST and without GST, in every report and export.
financials.whoOthers: Everyone else: the With GST books only. Sales and purchases without GST are not shown, exported or sent on WhatsApp.
financials.whoCa: CA or auditor: every transaction, read-only, for the dates Admin sets.
financials.statementsTitle: Profit and loss and balance sheet
financials.statementsBody: The statements under the Companies Act (Schedule III, Division I) are built from these books through the mapping Admin sets and the CA confirms.
